MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 88
   D. 22

5. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 100
   D. 50

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

7. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 46
   C. 30
   D. 120

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

16. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
